findings.title: Executable environment evidence is missing
findings.evidence: No container digest, lockfile digest, runtime digest, or notebook environment digest was provided.
findings.remediation: Attach a digest-pinned container, lockfile, runtime manifest, or archived notebook environment.

findings.title: Dataset working set exceeds stated system memory
findings.evidence: 1056 GB estimated working set vs 64 GB RAM with 4 GB reserved headroom.
findings.remediation: Provide a smaller reviewer fixture, streaming pipeline proof, shard plan, or larger reproducible hardware profile.

findings.title: GPU-resident workload exceeds available VRAM
findings.evidence: 1056 GB working set marked GPU-resident vs 24 GB total VRAM.
findings.remediation: Document gradient accumulation, checkpointing, offload, or a verified smaller fixture before release.

findings.title: Reviewer rerun time exceeds the stated review budget
findings.evidence: 38 hour rerun estimate vs 8 hour reviewer budget.
findings.remediation: Split the rerun into smoke, fixture, and full modes or disclose that full reproduction requires extended resources.

findings.title: Long rerun lacks checkpoint or resume evidence
findings.evidence: 38 hour run has no checkpoint/resume evidence in the packet.
findings.remediation: Attach a checkpoint manifest, restart transcript, or resumable workflow proof.

findings.title: Accelerator rerun lacks determinism controls
findings.evidence: cuda path is present without seed policy plus deterministic kernel/runtime controls.
findings.remediation: Document seed handling, deterministic kernel settings, tolerance windows, and accepted variance.

findings.title: Seed or variance policy is missing
findings.evidence: The assistant packet has no seed policy and no deterministic control list.
findings.remediation: Add seed policy, variance acceptance bands, and a rerun transcript showing stable outputs.

findings.title: Large data transfer lacks a reviewer fixture
findings.evidence: 620 GB download is required and no synthetic or reduced reviewer fixture is listed.
findings.remediation: Provide a small fixture, cached digest, or staged data-access plan with expected transfer time.

findings.title: Paid cloud or queued HPC requirement is not disclosed
findings.evidence: The packet requires paid cloud/HPC resources but does not disclose expected reviewer cost.
findings.remediation: State cost, queue assumptions, no-cost fixture alternative, and who bears the rerun cost.

findings.title: Long compute rerun lacks resource-impact disclosure
findings.evidence: No carbon/resource note is attached for a long-running rerun.
findings.remediation: Add a short resource-impact note and reviewer-facing rerun alternatives.

releaseGate.reviewerMessage: Hold or revise the assistant's reproducibility wording until compute feasibility evidence is repaired.
